description_en: Saves workspace code. If the file does not exist, a new file is automatically created
description_zh: 保存工作空间代码，如果文件不存在则自动新建
kebab_example: aliyun dms save-workspace-code --workspace-id 12345678 --path /Workspace/code/test.py --content print_123 --biz-force true --repo git@codeup.aliyun.com:test/abc.git --mtime 2026-01-01T10:11:12Z --iac false --region cn-hangzhou
name: SaveWorkspaceCode

parameters.description_en: The ID of the workspace to publish (numeric ID).
parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace to publish (numeric ID)
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether to forcibly overwrite the file regardless of whether it has been modified by others.
parameters.description_zh: 是否强制覆盖。不关心文件是否已经被其他改动，直接覆盖
parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to forcibly overwrite the file regardless of whether it has been modified by others
parameters.help_zh: 是否强制覆盖。不关心文件是否已经被其他改动，直接覆盖
parameters.name: force

parameters.description_en: The repository information. Pass this parameter when creating a git repo directory during the save action.
parameters.description_zh: 仓库信息。在save动作是创建一个 git repo 目录时传入
parameters.help_en: The repository information. Pass this parameter when creating a git repo directory during the save action
parameters.help_zh: 仓库信息。在save动作是创建一个 git repo 目录时传入
parameters.name: repo

parameters.description_en: The file modification time. The GetWorkspaceCode operation returns this mtime value. When calling SaveWorkspaceCode, include this mtime to compare against the server-side value. If the mtime does not match, the save fails, indicating that the server-side version has changed.
parameters.description_zh:
文件修改时间。GetWorkspaceCode接口会返回这个mtime，
在SaveWorkspaceCode的时候，带上这个mtime，来比对服务端是否有变化。
如果mtime不匹配会提示保存失败，说明服务端的版本有变更了
parameters.help_en: The file modification time. The GetWorkspaceCode operation returns this mtime value. When calling SaveWorkspaceCode, include this mtime to compare against the server-side value. If the mtime does not match, the save fails, indicating that the server-side version has changed

parameters.description_en: Specifies whether the file is an infrastructure as code template file. Set this parameter to true for YAML configuration files edited through the visual editor.
parameters.description_zh: 是否是iac的模板文件，可视化编辑的yaml配置文件，请设置为true
